candidates.name: Native scheduled audio engine
candidates.note: No app wrapper or direct named VMCALL caller found. Engine callers are its CABI and three VMCALL dispatch arms. Remove those together; preserve PCM playback, HDA and the separate synth.

candidates.name: Virtual gamepad automation station
candidates.note: No app producer found. Kernel references register/spawn the station and clean up owners; those keep it live without an app. Module explicitly says gamepads are not routed into UI4 yet. Preserve physical HID/gamepad support.

candidates.name: TUN CABI and its private handle table
candidates.note: Only the SDK Tun wrapper and kernel re-export refer to the CABI. Private TUN helpers feed that interface. Preserve TCP sockets and the shared VNet/OpenTun implementation.

candidates.name: Legacy Konsole row/cursor/end-frame exports
candidates.note: No app or dependency caller beyond trueos-v wrappers found. begin_frame IS imported and must remain. Frame state/helpers are shared with begin_frame and excluded from the estimate; removing these is only a partial interface cleanup.

candidates.name: Legacy zkVM-shaped sys_* exports
candidates.note: Four are kept looking used by std files selected only for target_os=zkvm. No kernel caller beyond resolver registration. SHA export has no consumer and only copies state; preserve sys_alloc_aligned, sys_rand, sys_read and sys_write.

candidates.name: Vendored Rayon demo package
candidates.note: Example package absent from the previous 58 resolved app unit graphs; current source is still a workspace member, not a production dependency. Remove the member entry with the directory; retain rayon/rayon-core. Source saving only; no linked-kernel saving claimed.

retained_after_review.name: Guest vVideoMem registration interface
retained_after_review.note: RETAIN: current boat and TRUEOS-Picasso-Example sources use VVideoMem and allocate_vvideo_mem despite no import in their existing packaged artifacts. This is a concrete stale-package false positive.
